62.sourceTitle: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest Price Today
62.evidenceText: The Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest price today is 1,793.99.
62.extractionRationale: The source states the price as 1,793.99. Based on typical market conventions for aluminum premiums, this figure is in cents per pound. Converted to USD per pound: 1,793.99 ÷ 100 = 17.94 USD/lb. Confidence is medium due to the source not explicitly stating the unit.
